name: vanilla-css
notes: Plain CSS is the classic defect source: physical margin plus physical alignment scanned lexically; the correct block with logical properties stays silent. The Persian content string in the stylesheet arms the evidence gate.

name: css-modules
notes: Module CSS scanned like plain CSS; class-name hashing and bundler mapping are not modeled. Arabic copy arms the gate; the logical padding twin stays silent.

name: tailwind
notes: Physical utilities detected lexically from class attributes; JIT output not required. Logical twins (ms/text-start) stay silent; translate is reported review-only.

name: bootstrap
notes: Bootstrap 5.3 rtl: build is fine — the logical margin utility ms-2 stays silent; inline physical styles remain the residual defect source and are caught lexically.

name: react-jsx
notes: Kebab-case declarations inside CSS-in-JS template literals are scanned like stylesheets. The camelCase style object (marginLeft: 8) fires the same rule: property names are normalized to kebab-case before matching, and the suggested fix stays camelCase (marginInlineStart). The logical inline-object twin stays silent.

name: next-jsx
notes: styled-jsx style blocks scanned like plain CSS; runtime styling and CSS resolution are not evaluated. dir on the wrapper is honored implicitly by the correct twin staying silent.

name: vue
notes: SFC style blocks scanned; template directives and compiler output are not parsed. The logical padding twin stays silent.

name: es-host
notes: LTR host profile: the direction rules flip — RTL runs inside Spanish prose must be isolated (RTL015) and RTL-only elements need dir (RTL016). The bdi-isolated paragraph stays silent, which is the engine's own recommendation pattern.

name: astro
notes: Astro page scanned as source text: frontmatter, template markup and the component style block are all read lexically in one pass. The physical margin declaration in the style block fires RTL001; the margin-inline-start twin stays silent. Compilation, islands and style scoping are not modeled.

name: svelte
notes: The SFC and the global stylesheet pair are both scanned: v0.4.2 added .svelte to the scanner's extension set, so the App.svelte style block fires RTL002 alongside the defect in src/app.css and both logical twins stay silent. Svelte compilation and component scoping are not modeled.

name: remix
notes: Route module scanned as source text; the inline critical-CSS template literal is read lexically like a stylesheet, so the physical alignment fires RTL004. Loaders, the compiler and runtime styling are not modeled; the text-align start twin stays silent.

name: nuxt
notes: Nuxt 3 root component app.vue scanned like the plain vue fixture: the SFC style block is read lexically while auto-imports and SSR output are not parsed. The physical margin declaration fires RTL001; the margin-inline-end twin stays silent.

name: vite
notes: Vanilla Vite trio: document, entry module and stylesheet are scanned as separate files, and the CSS evidence gate is per-file, so style.css carries its own Persian generated label. The physical alignment in the stylesheet fires RTL004; the text-align end twin stays silent and the clean document keeps proper root meta so no structure rules fire.

name: angular
notes: Angular trio scanned as three plain files: component class, external template and component stylesheet. templateUrl wiring and ViewEncapsulation rewriting are not modeled. The physical margin declaration in app.component.css fires RTL001; the margin-inline-start twin stays silent.
